entities.summary: The Pangu Pati, officially Papua na Niugini Yunion Pati, is a nationalist and developmentalist political party in Papua New Guinea. The party is the oldest political party in Papua New Guinea and has held all levels of government throughout its history. As of 2023, it is the largest party in the National Parliament.
